takeaways.en: Start from the question: compare categories (bar/column), show change over time (line), part of a whole (stacked bar, treemap, few-slice pie), relationship (scatter).
takeaways.zh: 从问题出发：比较类别（条形/柱形图）、显示随时间的变化（折线图）、部分与整体（堆积条形图、树状图、扇区少的饼图）、关系（散点图）。

takeaways.en: Cards and KPI visuals show single numbers; KPI and gauge compare a value with a target.
takeaways.zh: 卡片和 KPI 视觉对象显示单一数字；KPI 和仪表把数值与目标比较。

takeaways.en: Tables and matrices show detail; a matrix adds row/column groups, subtotals and drill-down.
takeaways.zh: 表格和矩阵显示明细；矩阵还有行/列分组、小计和向下钻取。

rows.en: How did a value change over time?
Line chart (area chart to stress volume)
rows.zh: 折线图（强调量时用面积图）

rows.en: Two measures with different scales over time
rows.zh: 两个尺度不同的度量值随时间变化
折线和簇状柱形图（组合图）

rows.en: Stacked bar/column, treemap; pie or donut only for a few slices
rows.zh: 堆积条形/柱形图、树状图；只有少数扇区时才用饼图或环形图

rows.en: How did we get from start to end?
Where do we lose people in a process?
Is there a relationship between two measures?
rows.zh: 两个度量值之间有关系吗？

rows.en: Scatter chart (bubble size = third measure; play axis = time)
rows.zh: 散点图（气泡大小 = 第三个度量值；播放轴 = 时间）
数值与目标比较并显示趋势

rows.en: Value within a range toward a goal
rows.zh: 数值在范围中朝目标前进

rows.en: Map, filled map, Azure Maps, shape map
rows.zh: 地图、着色地图、Azure Maps、形状地图

rows.en: Table; matrix for groups and subtotals
rows.zh: 表格；需要分组和小计时用矩阵

html.en: Beyond the built-in visuals you can import certified custom visuals from AppSource, or use R and Python visuals (they need R/Python installed in Desktop and have limits in the service).
html.zh: 除了内置的视觉对象，还可以从 AppSource 导入经过认证的自定义视觉对象，或使用 R 和 Python 视觉对象（Desktop 中需要安装 R/Python，在服务中也有限制）。

html.en: Avoid pies with many slices and 3-D effects: people compare lengths far more accurately than angles or areas.
html.zh: 避免扇区很多的饼图和 3D 效果：人们比较长度远比比较角度或面积准确。

q.en: You must show how revenue moved from last year's total to this year's, with the positive and negative contribution of each region. Which visual?
q.zh: 你要显示收入如何从去年的总额变成今年的总额，并呈现每个区域的正负贡献。用哪个视觉对象？

why.en: Right: it shows the running effect of increases and decreases.
why.zh: 对：它能显示增加和减少的累积效果。

q.en: Sales (millions) and margin % must share one time axis. Which visual fits?
q.zh: 销售额（百万）和利润率 % 要共用同一个时间轴。哪个视觉对象合适？

why.en: Right: columns for sales, a line on a secondary axis for margin %.
why.zh: 对：用柱形表示销售额，次坐标轴上的折线表示利润率 %。

why.en: Stacking a percentage on money is meaningless.
why.zh: 把百分比堆在金额上没有意义。

heading.zh: 设置视觉对象格式与主题

takeaways.en: The Format pane controls each visual: titles, axes, data labels, legend, colours, borders and spacing.
takeaways.zh: 「格式」窗格控制每个视觉对象：标题、轴、数据标签、图例、颜色、边框和间距。

takeaways.en: A report theme sets colours, fonts and visual defaults for every page at once; customise it or import a JSON theme file.
takeaways.zh: 报表主题一次性为所有页面设定颜色、字体和视觉对象默认值；可以自定义，或导入 JSON 主题文件。

takeaways.en: Use the theme for consistency; format individual visuals only for exceptions.
takeaways.zh: 用主题保持一致；只有特殊情况才单独设置个别视觉对象的格式。

html.en: Select a visual and open Format your visual. Settings are split into Visual (axes, data labels, legend, bars, lines) and General (title, effects, size, alt text, header icons). Use Format painter to copy formatting from one visual to another.
html.zh: 选取视觉对象，打开设置视觉对象格式。设置分为视觉对象（轴、数据标签、图例、条形、线条）和常规（标题、效果、大小、替代文字、标头图标）。用格式刷把一个视觉对象的格式复制到另一个。

items.en: View → Themes: pick a built-in theme, browse the theme gallery, or Customize current theme (name and colours, text, visuals, page, filter pane).
items.zh: 视图 → 主题：选择内置主题、浏览主题库，或自定义当前主题（名称和颜色、文本、视觉对象、页面、筛选器窗格）。

items.en: Browse for themes imports a JSON file; Save current theme exports one so other reports match your corporate style.
items.zh: 浏览主题可导入 JSON 文件；保存当前主题可导出，让其他报表符合公司风格。

items.en: Theme colours are used by every visual unless a visual overrides them.
items.zh: 除非个别视觉对象另行设定，所有视觉对象都会使用主题颜色。

q.en: Twenty reports must follow the corporate colour palette and fonts, and future changes should be quick. What is best?
q.zh: 二十份报表必须符合公司的配色和字体，而且以后的修改要很快。最好的方法是什么？

html.en: Use Format painter on every visual
html.zh: 对每个视觉对象使用格式刷

why.en: Slow and easy to miss visuals.

html.en: Create a JSON theme and import it into each report
html.zh: 建立 JSON 主题，导入到每份报表

why.en: Right: one file defines colours and fonts for every visual.
why.zh: 对：一个文件就能为所有视觉对象定义颜色和字体。

takeaways.en: Conditional formatting changes background colour, font colour, data bars, icons or links based on values.
takeaways.zh: 条件格式根据值改变背景色、字体颜色、数据条、图标或链接。

takeaways.en: Three ways to set it: gradient (colour scale), rules (if value is between…), or field value (a measure that returns a colour).
takeaways.zh: 三种设定方式：渐变（色阶）、规则（如果值介于……）或字段值（返回颜色的度量值）。

takeaways.en: A measure returning a hex colour lets one rule drive many visuals, including titles.
takeaways.zh: 返回十六进制颜色的度量值，可以让同一个规则驱动多个视觉对象，包括标题。

html.en: In a table or matrix, open the field's menu (or Format → Cell elements) and turn on Background color, Font color, Data bars, Icons or Web URL. Many charts also accept conditional colours for bars and titles through the fx button.
html.zh: 在表格或矩阵中，打开字段菜单（或「格式 → 单元格元素」），开启背景色、字体颜色、数据条、图标或 Web URL。许多图表也可以通过 fx 按钮为条形和标题设定条件颜色。

rows.en: Colour scale from lowest to highest value
rows.zh: 从最低值到最高值的色阶
明确的范围：< 0 红色、0–10% 琥珀色、> 10% 绿色

rows.en: A column or measure that returns a colour name or hex code
rows.zh: 返回颜色名称或十六进制代码的列或度量值

q.en: Bars in a column chart must turn red when the margin is negative, using the same rule as a table elsewhere in the report. What is the most maintainable approach?
q.zh: 柱形图中利润为负时柱子要变红，而且要和报表中另一个表格使用同一规则。最容易维护的做法是什么？

html.en: A measure returning a colour, used with Format style: Field value
html.zh: 一个返回颜色的度量值，配合格式样式「字段值」

why.en: Right: change the measure once and both visuals follow.
why.zh: 对：只要修改度量值一次，两个视觉对象都会跟着改。

html.zh: 在每个视觉对象上设置渐变格式

why.en: Manual colours do not react to data.
why.zh: 手动颜色不会随数据变化。

takeaways.en: The Filters pane has three scopes: this visual, this page, all pages — plus drill-through filters on target pages.
takeaways.zh: 「筛选器」窗格有三种范围：此视觉对象、此页、所有页——另外还有目标页上的钻取筛选器。

takeaways.en: Filter types include basic, advanced, Top N and relative date/time.
takeaways.zh: 筛选类型包括基本、高级、前 N 个和相对日期/时间。

takeaways.en: Slicers are filters on the canvas that users see and click; lock or hide filters in the pane to control what users can change.
takeaways.zh: 切片器是放在画布上、用户能看到和点击的筛选器；可在窗格中锁定或隐藏筛选器，控制用户能改动什么。

rows.zh: 此视觉对象上的筛选器

rows.en: The target page when a user drills through to it
rows.zh: 用户钻取到目标页时作用于该页

rows.en: Name contains "Pro" and does not start with "X"

rows.zh: 按 [Total Sales] 的前 10 个产品

rows.en: Is in the last 12 calendar months
rows.zh: 在最近 12 个日历月内
度量值筛选（视觉对象级）

rows.en: Show items when [Total Sales] is greater than 1,000
rows.zh: 当 [Total Sales] 大于 1,000 时显示项目

html.en: Slicer styles include vertical list, tile/button, dropdown, between (range), relative date and hierarchy. Single-select, "Select all" and search can be switched on. A slicer filters the visuals on its page by default; use Edit interactions to exclude some, and Sync slicers to carry it to other pages.
html.zh: 切片器样式包括垂直列表、磁贴/按钮、下拉、介于（范围）、相对日期和层次结构。可以开启单选、「全选」和搜索。切片器默认筛选所在页面的视觉对象；用编辑交互排除部分视觉对象，用同步切片器延伸到其他页面。

items.en: Lock filter: users see the filter but cannot change it.
items.zh: 锁定筛选器：用户看得到筛选器但不能修改。

items.en: Hide filter: users do not see it in reading view (it still applies — it is not security).
items.zh: 隐藏筛选器：阅读视图中用户看不到它（仍然生效——但这不是安全措施）。

items.en: Filters on a measure ("Total Sales is not blank") are only available at visual level.
items.zh: 对度量值的筛选（「Total Sales 不为空」）只能在视觉对象级使用。

html.en: Hidden filters are not security: users with Build permission or Analyze in Excel can still reach the data. To restrict data per user, use row-level security.
html.zh: 隐藏的筛选器不是安全措施：有生成权限或使用「在 Excel 中分析」的用户仍能取得数据。要按用户限制数据，应使用行级别安全性。

q.en: A report must always show only the last 6 months, updating automatically each day. Which filter?
q.zh: 某报表必须始终只显示最近 6 个月，并每天自动更新。用哪种筛选器？

html.en: Relative date filter: in the last 6 months
html.zh: 相对日期筛选：在最近 6 个月内

why.en: Right: it moves with today's date.
why.zh: 对：它会随着今天的日期移动。

html.en: Basic filter ticking the six months
html.zh: 基本筛选，勾选那六个月

why.en: It stays on the same months forever.
why.zh: 会永远停留在那几个月。

html.zh: 按日期的前 N 个 6

q.en: A filter on Region must apply to every page of a 12-page report. Where do you add it?
q.zh: Region 筛选器必须作用于 12 页报表的每一页。应该加在哪里？

html.en: Filters on this page, on each page
html.zh: 在每一页的「此页上的筛选器」

why.en: Works, but twelve copies to maintain.

takeaways.en: Page settings control canvas size (16:9, 4:3, Letter, custom, Tooltip), background, wallpaper and whether the page is hidden.
takeaways.zh: 页面设置控制画布大小（16:9、4:3、Letter、自定义、工具提示）、背景、壁纸，以及页面是否隐藏。

takeaways.en: Paginated reports (.rdl) are pixel-perfect, print-ready reports that run over many pages, built with Power BI Report Builder.
takeaways.zh: 分页报表（.rdl）是像素级精确、可直接打印、可跨越多页的报表，用 Power BI 报表生成器制作。

takeaways.en: Choose paginated when users need to print, export every row to PDF/Excel, or produce invoices and statements.
takeaways.zh: 当用户需要打印、把所有行导出为 PDF/Excel，或制作发票和对账单时，选择分页报表。

items.en: Canvas settings: type (16:9, 4:3, Letter, Tooltip, Custom), height and width, vertical alignment.
items.zh: 画布设置：类型（16:9、4:3、Letter、工具提示、自定义）、高度和宽度、垂直对齐。
画布背景（页面内）和壁纸（页面外围）。

items.en: Page information: name, "Allow use as tooltip", drill-through settings.
items.zh: 页面信息：名称、「允许用作工具提示」、钻取设置。

items.en: Hide page for drill-through targets and tooltip pages, so they do not appear as tabs.
items.zh: 隐藏页面：用于钻取目标页和工具提示页，不让它们显示为选项卡。

items.en: Page view: Fit to page, Fit to width, Actual size.
items.zh: 页面视图：调整到页面大小、适应宽度、实际大小。

rows.en: Printing, PDF, every row of a long table, fixed layouts
rows.zh: 打印、PDF、长表格的每一行、固定版式

rows.en: One canvas per page; visuals scroll
rows.zh: 每页一个画布；视觉对象内滚动

rows.en: Grows over as many pages as the data needs; headers and footers repeat
rows.zh: 数据有多少就延伸多少页；页眉页脚会重复

rows.en: Invoices, statements, operational lists, regulatory filings
rows.zh: 发票、对账单、操作清单、监管报表

q.en: Finance needs a 40-page printable list of every transaction with page headers and totals, exported to PDF each month. What do you build?
q.zh: 财务部门每月需要一份 40 页、列出所有交易、带页眉和合计、可导出 PDF 打印的清单。应该制作什么？

html.en: A paginated report in Power BI Report Builder
html.zh: 用 Power BI 报表生成器制作分页报表

why.en: Right: paginated reports flow over pages and print exactly.
why.zh: 对：分页报表会跨页延伸，打印效果精确。

html.en: A table visual exported to PDF
html.zh: 把表格视觉对象导出为 PDF

why.en: A Power BI report page exports only what fits on the canvas.
why.zh: Power BI 报表页只会导出画布上显示得下的内容。

takeaways.en: A visual calculation is DAX defined on one visual and calculated on the data that visual already shows.
takeaways.zh: 视觉计算是在单个视觉对象上定义的 DAX，基于该视觉对象已显示的数据进行计算。

takeaways.en: Functions such as RUNNINGSUM, MOVINGAVERAGE, PREVIOUS, FIRST and COLLAPSE make running totals and comparisons easy.
takeaways.zh: RUNNINGSUM、MOVINGAVERAGE、PREVIOUS、FIRST 和 COLLAPSE 等函数让累计总计和比较变得容易。

takeaways.en: They are not stored in the model, so other visuals and reports cannot reuse them.
takeaways.zh: 它们不存储在模型中，所以其他视觉对象和报表无法重用。

html.en: Select a visual and choose New visual calculation (Home ribbon or the visual's menu). An edit mode shows the visual's data as a small grid; you write DAX that refers to the fields in the visual by name, and can start from templates such as Running sum or Moving average.
html.zh: 选取视觉对象，选择新建视觉计算（「主页」功能区或视觉对象菜单）。编辑模式会把视觉对象的数据显示为小网格；你写的 DAX 可直接按名称引用视觉对象中的字段，也可以从「累计求和」「移动平均」等模板开始。

blocks.text:
Running total   = RUNNINGSUM ( [Sales Amount] )
3-month average = MOVINGAVERAGE ( [Sales Amount], 3 )
vs previous     = [Sales Amount] - PREVIOUS ( [Sales Amount] )
% of parent     = DIVIDE ( [Sales Amount], COLLAPSE ( [Sales Amount], ROWS ) )

rows.en: The model, under the visual's filters
rows.zh: 模型，在视觉对象的筛选下

rows.en: The rows and columns of the visual itself
rows.zh: 视觉对象自身的行和列

rows.en: Business logic shared by all reports
rows.zh: 所有报表共用的业务逻辑

rows.en: Running totals, moving averages, % of parent in one chart
rows.zh: 单一图表中的累计总计、移动平均、占父级百分比

q.en: A user wants a running total in one matrix only, without adding a measure to the shared model. What fits?
q.zh: 某用户只想在一个矩阵中显示累计总计，又不想在共享模型中新增度量值。哪个合适？

html.zh: 使用 RUNNINGSUM 的视觉计算

why.en: Right: it lives in the visual and needs no model change.
why.zh: 对：它存在于视觉对象中，不需要修改模型。
